steps.text: It is said that one who has ascended to Xiandom dwells deep in the forest, one who knows the way of Heaven, one whom the clouds follow from dawn to dusk.
There is no telling what is real and what is not within the clouds.
The only thing that points the way is a heart that seeks the truth.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: *pant* *pant*... The fog's getting thicker.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This place looks familiar. Have I already been here?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Still no signal from the drone, and no one to ask directions...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: A girl from the mountains? Ni hao! I...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Hey, I just wanted to ask the way—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Alright, alright, don't run, I'm not chasing you! It's dangerous running through the mountains in this fog!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: She wants me to follow her?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This is the path I took up the mountain... Seems like I've been going around in circles.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Oh, ni hao.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: This path will take you down the mountain.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I'm not trying to go down. I heard of a plot of farmland in the middle of a forest here. Do you know where it is? It's so hard to find the way in this fog.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: I've never heard of any place like that. You've heard some random rumors, just like the other tourists.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It's not a rumor... I can prove it. I have a picture of the farm here. Does it look familiar?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Never seen it. Don't believe everything you hear. Leave before nightfall, if you know what's good for you.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You hardly looked at it... but I suppose you weren't even born when the photo was taken. Sorry for bothering you. I'll keep looking.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Assuming it exists, isn't it strange that any living soul would want to live there, where there's no water, electricity, or anyone nearby? Unless—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Well, it's getting late. You should get home before it's totally dark. Be careful.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: You're still going into the mountains... you just don't listen, do you?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The one who lives there is a very experienced... hey, where did she go?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This fog again.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Reports say fog covers this place nine days out of ten, all year round. There's no time to wait for the fog to disperse. I have to try my luck.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Still no signal from the drone, and visibility keeps getting worse. This is weird. Could it be like the girl said...?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: No, no, have faith in science.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Wait... was this path there just now?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What is this place? Brr, it's cold. Shouldn't I still be halfway up the mountain?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Wait, this forest—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It looks exactly the same as the one in the photo. That clearing up there must be—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: That's the field—!
There is a plot of farmland in the misty woods. A few stalks of bean grow on the edge amongst some weeds. There is no snow in a large area around it.
He Sheng crouches down and starts measuring the beans with his Tianshi apparatus, comparing them to his failed attempts.
The pods are at the perfect height, of a cold-resistant breed, and growing on the shaded side of the mountain. It must be the work of the one he is seeking.
He Sheng leaps up and casts his gaze across the farm, towards the lone hut standing in the fog, and runs for the faint silhouette without a thought.
At first he's running...
But soon he starts to hesitate, and slows to a walk...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Clay jar, miniature pine, weeder.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Again. Clay jar, miniature pine, weeder. One step, two steps, three steps, clay jar, miniature pine, weeder.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I'm not moving forward at all! I can't close the distance.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Maybe I'll take a detour...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What if I leap from the trees?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Arrrggghhh—
Try as he might, he cannot reach the hut that seems so close. He sits by the side with his head hanging low. The weeds in the field add to his frustration, so he decides to clean them out.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: That's better... it's so humid. The weeder's almost sticking to my hand.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I can't just sit around... what should I do next?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You again, kid? Aren't your parents worried about you being out here so late?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: If you've come to seek the secrets of ascension from the Xian, you've come to the wrong place. Don't waste your time.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Y-You know him, don't you?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I guess I've come to seek secrets, but not about ascension. He's a Nongye Tianshi I've never met. There's something really important that I need to ask him...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It's been bothering me for a long time.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: He won't be back for another few years.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Why are you trying to chase me away then? You were really eager to get me to leave before, back when I was halfway up.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: I-I wasn't! I just didn't want you to waste your time!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Waste my time? All his work is here.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Did he ask you to pass on a message?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Hm... you're not as dumb as you look.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Alright. He wants you to... er...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Well, uh—
The girl makes circles with her fingers, pointing from the farmland to the foothills.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: The one who seeks is the same as ever. Do you understand?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: (Farmland, circle, same as ever.)

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The author of this thesis went on a journey? Does anyone know how to reach him?

steps.name: Displeased Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Hmph, you want to reach him? You have no idea how he despises us for being 'polluted by worldly matters'. I'm surprised he even waited to finish his thesis before leaving!

steps.name: Displeased Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: No one has heard from him since then. No one knows where he went.

steps.name: Displeased Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Why? Do you absolutely need his help with a project?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Yes, I want to develop a 'High Pod Mk2' that can be harvested by machine and grows well in shade and cold, but I haven't been able to get the results I wanted. I've been stuck for half a year now...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I must be missing something.

steps.name: Displeased Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: I tell you what, there's something you can try. Look in the database...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I've been over the agricultural news, but I haven't seen anything that might have something to do with this Tianshi.

steps.name: Displeased Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: No. What I mean is, look for local legends and rumors—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This tea's really bitter, but it does wake you up. Kind of serves as medicine.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Phew—let's keep going. There's so much gossip and rumor that my eyes are glazing over... where was I?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: 'Water fighting water monsters'... 'One color missing from the seven-colored auspicious clouds'... 'Smell of fried noodles from abandoned well'... nothing relevant.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: 'Opera-singing cloudbeast'? I should forward this to Grain Buds.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: 'The Xian who guides in the mists'... This came not long after that thesis.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Wait, this picture...
He Sheng zooms in and presses his face against the screen, staring at the farmland in the middle of the image.
The crops in the field are faintly visible through the fog. He Sheng's eyes grow wider as he identifies them.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: M-Master! I...
The Xian who guides in the mists.
Rumor has it that this ascended Xian dwells on the peak of a mountain that is forever shrouded by auspicious clouds.
No one has seen the Xian's face, but those who walk into the fog have their questions answered, and the way shown to them.
Truth and lies, reality and illusion, all are revealed at the Xian's guidance.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Xian's guidance... I see.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: (Farmland, circle, same as ever.)

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Now I get it!
You said you passed on my message?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Y-Yes.
Did you tell him unambiguously to get lost?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Well, pretty much, I suppose...
Then why is he still here and plowing my farm?!

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Judging from the gadget he's using to plow and the silver patterns on his clothes, I guess he came from the Tianshi Bureau too, much like yourself?

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: You know from the start that he needs your guidance for his questions.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: He was polite, so I responded in kind. I made circular gestures with my hands to subtly suggest that he should get going. Oh... Maybe he misunderstood and interpreted it as an instruction to plow.

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: What...!

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: Listen, tell him this, and don't you change a single word this time—

a.text: Your homework is not my problem!
You've got a brain, so use it for your own research!
If you don't have one, go home and eat some walnuts!
—Former Nongye Tianshi (author of 'A New Technological Prospect for Increasing Soybean Yield')

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You again? Oh my... Is it already this late?!
He Sheng wipes his sweat and realizes that he was so occupied with plowing that he hardly thought about the meaning behind the elder Tianshi's advice.
Like a student who forgot his homework, he wishes he could hide inside his Tianshi apparatus.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Ahem... the Xian, he says...

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Your homework is... er...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Homework? So he knows why I'm here. But I'm not sure I understood the hint.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I know that research isn't about working for its own sake. I need to think deeper about it.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: ('Your homework is not my problem!'... 'Go home and eat some walnuts!'... How am I supposed to tell him that?!)

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: He says that... um, one must learn to be independent... and, uh, don't just stay on the farms, it's time to leave and get some nutrition.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Nutrition.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: No, no, the first part is the important one. Leave.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Leave and get some nutrition.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Ah, I understand now! I'll be going!

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: What? You're really going?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Yeah, no better time than now!
The mountain is covered in clouds and the curtain of night. The forests are silent, except for soft footsteps.
Slowly, the sound of liquid sloshing and splashing spreads in the mist and cloud, along with a peculiar odor.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Hm... *sniff*... uh...

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: What's that sound... and smell...?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Oh... whoa... AAAHHHH!

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Th-That guy came back with fertilizer! He's dissolving it in water and spraying it on the field!

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: What's going on... Is that what he thought was 'nutrition'?

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: What nutrition?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Ah! N-Nothing! Absolutely nothing at all.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Well, maybe it's slightly my fault... A-Anyways, what do you want to say to him this time? I'll definitely, absolutely pass it on word for word.

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: Just give this to him. No need to say anything.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: This... It's from your farm...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Good morning. Do you bring new instructions?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This is... three soybean seeds?
He Sheng looks back and forth between the soybeans in the fields and the seeds in his hand, then at the field beside him. His furrowed brow gradually begins to relax.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I see. All is revealed. I completely understand what he means now!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It began when I removed the weeds in the fields by chance. He saw and guided me to plow the field and fertilize it, all in preparation for this moment—planting these three seeds.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: He's encouraging me to continue!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I must thank him for his guidance, and grow these seeds with all the knowledge I possess!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The fog's getting thicker? W-Well, I won't give up.
He Sheng sits down and opens his bag, taking out various items, including a portable soil analyzer, drone, experiment logbook, labels, and beakers.
After the preparations, he grabs a bunch of soil and sniffs it, silently saying 'hello' to it.
The next day...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I've finished planting, sir. Here is the data collected today.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It's foggy and wet today, which may be hard on one's joints. I've made some ginger tea for you to keep you warm. I'll put it here.
Two days later...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Today is the second day after planting. I've come to report the data.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I made porridge with some grains from Dahuang. I didn't add any sugar and let it cook until the grains were nice and soft. It should be easy on your teeth and blood sugar.
Six days later...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Tomorrow, we will know if the seeds will sprout.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: To be honest, I'm not expecting much, considering that I've failed for the past six months.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Maybe I was going down the wrong path. My seeds require too much sunlight, and they don't grow tall enough to be harvested by machine.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I wanted to ask how you planted them. I saw a few on the farm that were the ideal height. I was hoping there would be more, so that I could take a few seeds back...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Do you mean there's no need to overthink it? Right. I will focus on my work then.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Uh... let me repeat the Xian's message, word by word—

a.text: 'Is farming the only thing rattling around in that head of yours? If you love sitting in a field and munching on a diet of wind, you might as well become a weed!'

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Umm?

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Ahem... I'll add my explanation just in case you don't understand: Haven't you forgotten something important?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Data? Let me check.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Put down the data. Think about it. At first, you were still bringing food to the Xian...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Oh no! Is the Xian—

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Stop. What I mean is—have you eaten in the past two days?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Oh, you're right!
Seven days later...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The soybeans are entering their sprouting period, but there's no sign of sprouting.
Eight days later...
Nine days later...

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: He's been quiet these past few days.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: Pretty evil of you to give him seeds that won't sprout.

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: Academia loves serious people like him. But there's one thing that he doesn't see—

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: The brick wall.

steps.name: Girl in the Mountains
steps.text: If you want him to learn to give up, why are you still pacing like that? You're making me dizzy. If you're worried, I'll go check on him.

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: No need. Once he hits that brick wall, he'll go home on his own.

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: Though with his stubborn attitude, that wall could be the death of him. Can't have that happening in my fields.
He Sheng is lying down on the bare fields, his palms against the soil, gazing silently up at the sky.
He feels an odd sense that the hut he can never reach seems even further away now, disappearing into the fog and out of sight.
Not just the hut, but everything around him. The fences are gone, the forest is gone. All that is left is this farmland and the sky above his head.
The soil and the sky—the two most important things to a farmer.
He seems to hear a tiny sound from the soil...
Bang!
The sound of a wooden door being kicked open snaps him back. He Sheng turns from where he is lying and sees an unfamiliar young man emerging from the fog—
He Sheng narrows his eyes in confusion.
What is WRONG with you?! How are you still planting those seedings?
When my master had me plant the second seed, I already knew that it was a dud and that it was time to change direction.
You, though, just don't get it even after so many days. I had to come out and actually say it to your face—
You hoped there would be more beanstalks in my field? Well, have you stopped to think why there are so few even after so many years?!
If it takes hitting a brick wall for you to turn around, then you're just not cut out for research...
The tirade comes to a sudden stop when he sees the field beside He Sheng.
He Sheng stares in disbelief at the surprisingly young man whom he thought would be an elderly Tianshi.
The young man, however, stares in greater disbelief at the beanstalk next to He Sheng. The sprout is green and crooked, but it has, indeed, sprouted.
He Sheng looks upward to see the fog has dispersed, revealing a clear blue sky.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I, er, was trying to be a weed, though I'm not sure how it should feel...

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: What?! I meant you were dumb as a weed, not that you should BECOME a weed!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: But if I listen carefully, it's as if I can hear—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The sound of the sprout breaking through the seed shell and growing outwards.

steps.name: 'Ascended Xian'
steps.text: You're hallucinating because of hunger! Get up!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: No, I really do hear...
The Xian slaps him back and forth.
Get up! Get up, you!
Stop sleeping, Big Buffalo!
A soybean leaf slaps He Sheng on the face repeatedly.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: How could you fall asleep during the bean harvest? Get up, you stupid buffalo!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: You're gonna get run over by a harvester!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Grain Buds? Did I... fall asleep?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: You told me to come watch the first harvest of your 'High Pod Mk3', yet you're taking a nap yourself!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Anyway, it's no fun watching machines harvest beans. I've seen enough. Let's go play with Mianmian!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Oh, I saw that 'Opera-singing cloudbeast' thing you sent me last time. Mianmian says he doesn't like opera, but he wants to give rock n' roll a go.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Wanna come and listen? It'll make him real happy!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: No, I still have a lot of analysis to do after the harvest.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Pfft. Then I'll tell Shu that you were napping in the fields.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You do you, I'm not going.
The girl makes a face and disappears from sight.
He Sheng rises from the soybean field, watching as the harvester glides smoothly through the rows. Amidst the rumble of machinery, he could almost hear the sound of beans maturing.
